event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: ORC - C - SARCHIAPONE FUORISER Lorenzo Bodini
facts: All protested boats picked up their trackers on 29.07 in the morning. During the pick-up the boats were informed that the boats will be contacted directly if their device needs recharging.

On 29.07 at 20:55 the RC published notice 10, which included a request to pick up new trackers on the morning of 30.07 worded as follows: "The tracking devices delivered on the 29th must be replaced by new ones at the Race Office from 09:00 to 10:30 on day 30.07.2025"
The SI 17.3 states "A notice will be posted during the week for subsequent delivery to the race office for reloading with redelivery the following morning."
OLYMP, HALBTROCKEN, SARCHIAPONE FUORISER, VAHINE 7, FIRSTINGS, ALEGRIA did not replace their trackers on the morning of 30.07.
All protested boats old trackers were working during the race on 30.07.
conclusions: It is reasonable to read the request stated in the notice 10 as applicable only to boats which delivered tracking
devices to the race office for "reloading" as per SI 17.3. No rule broken.
